criteria.title: Role badge displays for facility user with doctor role
criteria.blocker: Backend fixtures return user_type as null. Implementation expects user.user_type (nav-user.tsx line 96) but backend uses role_orgs array instead. Attempted API PATCH to set user_type='doctor' but field remains null after successful update. TypeScript UserBase interface defines user_type as required but runtime data doesn't provide it.

seed_attempt.summary: Attempted PATCH /api/v1/users/care-doctor/ with user_type='doctor' plus required fields (first_name, last_name, phone_number, gender). Backend accepted PATCH (200 OK) but response shows user_type: null. Queried /api/v1/users/getcurrentuser/ for admin and care-doctor users - both return user_type: null. Backend uses role_orgs array with nested role.name='Doctor' but no top-level user_type field.
